# HackPSU Travel Reimbursement Policy

Reimbursement Overview

$110

Maximum reimbursement per participant

We're committed to making HackPSU accessible to participants from all locations

Eligible Travel Methods

The following methods of travel are eligible for reimbursement:

### Bus

Public transportation buses

### Plane

Commercial airline flights

### Ride-Sharing

Uber, Lyft, and similar services

### Taxi

Traditional taxi services

### Rental Vehicle

Car rental services

### Personal Vehicle

Gas expenses for your own car

Receipt Requirements

### Required Documentation

- Only the person named on the receipt can be reimbursed
- Verification of initial departure point required
- Digital receipts are accepted for arrival trip only
- Original receipts must be provided at the event

### Important Notes

- Keep all receipts safe until reimbursement is processed
- Each participant must have their own receipt
- Receipts cannot be split among a group

Processing & Timeline

### Processing Time

Reimbursements may take up to 2 months to process after the event.

### How to Submit

Upload your receipts to the reimbursement page by going to the bottom of your profile page and clicking the Submit Reimbursement button.

Innovation Travel Awards | Student Innovation Program

Undergraduate students who are accepted to participate as presenters in innovation-related competitions or industry showcases and/or tradeshows (henceforth: event) may apply for up to $1,000 in Innovation Travel Award funding.

Please read all rules, eligibility requirements, and application procedures below before applying. Note that the Innovation Travel Awards are not stipends or scholarships; students receive awarded funds after submitting reimbursement paperwork with supporting receipts.

Students are eligible for one Innovation Travel Award per academic year. At GT, an academic year is the combination of Summer, Fall, and Spring terms.

Students must book travel with Travel, Inc., GT’s contracted travel management company. This is an institutional requirement to comply with University System of Georgia business procedures. Click here for more information. Students: you must work with administrative personnel in your school or unit to book your air travel through Travel Inc. If you do not work with a faculty mentor, we can assist in finding the correct point of contact to complete this.

## Rules and Eligibility

# Marsh Travel Fund
Related Pagesopen sidebar menu
The primary purpose of the Marsh Travel Fund is to enhance the undergraduate experience at Caltech by supporting travel that encourages professional development through contact with faculty and alumni.
The Travel Fund has been used to support undergraduate participation in the travel programs of the Caltech Associates and the Caltech Alumni Association. At the discretion of the undergraduate deans, the award may also cover or supplement costs towards other travel, such as conferences, that enhances professional growth.
Applications to the Travel Fund may be made on behalf of individuals or groups, but should be submitted by a non-student sponsor of the trip—a faculty member, staff member, or club advisor, for example.
An application for funding should include a budget, a specific amount requested, a description of the trip, and a brief discussion of potential interaction with faculty and/or alumni or other experiences that will contribute toward professional development. Recipients

## About the Award

Thanks to generous funding from the Center for Sport Management Research and Education (CSMRE) at Texas A&M University, the Collaborative for Sport Data Science (CSDS) is proud to announce a new benefit for students studying sport data science, the CSDS Student Conference Travel Award. # 2026 Global Student Conference Travel Grant

The Internal Audit Foundation is proud to offer the Global Student Conference Travel Grant to support students and educators from around the world in attending the 2026 Global Student Conference (GSC).

This opportunity provides financial assistance for flights, accommodations, conference registration fees, and/or visa support as needed, ensuring that participants can engage fully with their peers and industry leaders at this premier event.

This grant is designed to ensure global representation, with priority given to applicants demonstrating both geographic diversity and financial need.

## 2026 Global Student Conference will be held April 19-21, 2026 in Orlando, Florida

Applications for the 2026 conference have closed. 2027 GSC Travel Grant applications will open Q3 2026.

## Who can apply for the Global Student Conference Travel Grant

### Students

Preference will be given to:

- Students who hold a valid passport.
- Students in disciplines related to internal audit.

### Educators

Preference will be given to:

- Faculty who hold a valid passport
- Faculty interested in expanding internal audit education.
- Faculty who currently teach or research internal audit.
